name: Elecon Engineering Company Ltd
title: Elecon Engineering Company Ltd - 505700 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Gear revenue fell 21% YoY to INR472 crore on deferred dispatches and no FY27 guidance; utilisation only 56-60% with ~INR800 crore idle investments, so supply discipline is strong but demand timing is weak.

utilisation.quote: we are at this moment with the addition of capex is around 56% to 60% utilization is there.

capex.quote: we have roughly spent about INR95 crores towards different -different categories.

triggers.label: FY27 guidance held, not given
triggers.quote: we are holding our guidance for FY '27 at this stage and will revisit our outlook

triggers.label: Gear order book INR894 crore
triggers.quote: the open order book that we have is about INR894 crores as of March 31, 2026

triggers.label: EBITDA target 22-24% if demand returns
triggers.quote: we will be able to go back to the EBITDA levels that we had suggested even earlier, which is close to 22% to 24%

guidance.quote: As previously communicated, we will not be providing forward -looking guidance for FY27.
